newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan cancels Oct jet fuel buy tender-official.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan cancels Oct jet fuel buy tender-official.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has cancelled a tender to buy jet fuel for delivery in October, a company official said on Thursday.

CPC had not made any decision whether or not to issue a new tender for the same cargo. "We will see how the market develops over the next few days. It (issuing a new tender) is a possibility," the official said.
"We may choose to check with the front runners and make a decision in the next few days," the official added.
CPC said the offers it received ranged from just under $250 to over $260 per tonne cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender to buy 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel for October 10-20 delivery, c-and-f Keelung or Shen Ao, closed on September 4.
The offer prices were around $20 above the awarded level in its last jet fuel tender for September 20-30 delivery which was awarded at $228.50 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
